t: A USB stick with a small FPGA chip for learning digital hardware design.
steps: Buy the iCEstick from DigiKey, Mouser or Arrow. Prices seen in 2026 are about 149 to 168 US dollars.
Plug it into a USB 2.0 port on your computer. Some USB 3.0 ports have caused problems.
Install the open tools Yosys, nextpnr, IceStorm and iceprog. Linux is the smoothest path.
On Windows, swap the USB driver with the free Zadig app.
Build the rot example from the Project IceStorm docs.
Upload it with iceprog and watch the LEDs spin.
Try the IceStudio app next as another way to build designs.
meta: Open Board. From $149. A few stores.
